---
title: "زہراؑ تجھے دربار میں حق کیوں نہ ملا ہے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Zehra tujhay darbar may haq kiyun na mila hay

1
Shayed ke yehi ajr-e-risalat ka sila hay

2
1) Mehroom rahi haq se to ummat ki satai
Jhutlayi shareefon ne teri pak gawahi
Is ghum ne teray dil ka sakoon cheen liya hay

3
2) Ehsan faramoshon ne hay tujh ko rulaya
Aur baad nabi kyun saqeefay may bulaya
Choda so baras se humain yeh hi gilla hay

4
3) Darwaza teray pehlu pe zalim ne giraya
Kyun bint mohammad pay ussay reham na aaya
Kis jurm may zalim ne yehi zakhm dia hay

5
4) Matam teri aulaad ka din raat karain gay
Parhtay hain ager kalma to haq baat karain gay
Jannat teri aulaad ko ronay ka sila hay

6
5) Farman e risalat ko jo bhoolein hain woh zalim
Beshak woh namazi hain ya deen kay hain aalim
Un kay liye Sardar jahanum ki saza hay

roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
def blocks(s):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in u] == [1, 2, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4]
assert [b[0].strip() for b in r[1:]] == list('123456')
assert [b[0] for b in u[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶')
print('Verified 17 verse lines in each script, with matching opening and stanza layout.')
PY"

item.text: Reconstructed the Urdu body and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have 17 verse lines, with the same opening and six numbered stanzas. Added the Roman alternate title, set right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag. I read “Choda so” as `چودہ سو` and retained “Sardar” as `سردار`.
